# Cracktro deck mechanics

Bands, navigation, transitions, audio and animated SVG flows in `docs/public/cracktro/deck.js`. Load when changing slide order, groups, transitions, sound or a flow diagram.

- **Bands:** the deck is a table of rows. A slide's `group` is its band: `intro` (title), `platform`, `security`, `mindset` (header-less, like the title and finale), `process`, `cost`, `engineering`, `enterprise`, `data`, `finale`. Rows follow each group's first appearance in the source, except that the `finale` row is always moved last, so changing a slide's `group` moves it to that band without moving its code. Every human/agent process slide (swimlane flows with `SEQ`/`LANE`, code quality, specs and docs) belongs in `process` ("Human agent processes"); The `// ---------- bands ----------` block (before `const stage`) holds `BANDS` (id → header title/subtitle), builds `rows`, and inserts a generated header slide (`header: true`, `bh-` classes, tiles with `data-go` that wrap into a 7-column grid above 8 slides (10 columns above 14) and use the kicker when a heading exceeds 32 characters, plus a band map) at the start of every band except `intro` and `finale`. Each slide then gets `s.band` and each row `r.start`. Slide numbers are absolute and include headers, so adding a slide renumbers everything after it. Only `slides.md` holds numbers: add, move or remove the slide's row there (the tests read it) and nothing else. Headers and slides share their band's `THEME`.
- **Navigation:** Left/Right/Space/PageUp/PageDown step in reading order and wrap between bands (Left on a header goes to the last slide of the band above). Up/Down call `band(±1)`, which always jumps to the first slide (header) of the band above/below (`rows[b].start`); no per-band cursor is kept. The dots are a mini-map with one `.drow` per band. Vertical swipes also switch bands.
- **Band themes:** `THEME` (the `// ---------- band themes ----------` block, before bands) is the single source of each band's look and sound; slides never set `sound`, `palette` or `red`. An entry is `{ base, pal, grid: [r,g,b,minorA,majorA], ang, cell, accent, red?, music, prog }`: background fill, four glow colours, grid colour and alphas, grid angle, minor cell size (major lines every 5 cells), header colours, the red security wash (`go()` covers entry with it), the `MUSIC` key played on entering every slide of the band, and per-step semitone shifts (`prog[step % length]`) so the band's music varies along it. Current bands: intro green/neutral 0°, platform teal 15°, security red wash 45°, mindset ember -15°, process blueprint blue 0°, cost gold -45°, engineering purple 30°, enterprise steel slate -30° (wide cells), data plum 0° (fine cells), finale neutral. Each band uses a distinct hue and orientation; the background, grid angle and cell size ease between bands. Keep body text #e6edf3 ≥ 7:1 and muted #8b949e ≥ 4:1 against the brightest glow overlap.
- **Transitions:** derived from `group`. Siblings in a band use a reveal-style horizontal push (`slide-in`/`slide-out`); `show()` sets `--dx` to `100%` going forward, `-100%` going back, and `0%` on first load. Crossing into another band slides up (`up-in`/`up-out`) going forward and down (`down-in`/`down-out`) going back. All use the same 0.8 s curve. Every slide needs a `group`; never add per-slide transition overrides. The old slide keeps the `.leaving` class until a timeout clears it.
- **Audio isolation:** `master` is a persistent gain that feeds the compressor and delay. `out` is a per-slide bus. `show()` calls `sfx.cut()`, which fades the current bus and replaces it, so long themes cannot leak into the next slide. Any new sound must connect to `out`, or to `master` if it must persist across slides (as techno does).
- **CSS animations restart** through `void el.offsetWidth` before `.active` is added. Prefer `.active .x { animation: ... }` for entry effects.
- **Animated SVG flow diagrams** (for example "Daily Unsloppers"):
  - Built with helpers such as `agent()`, `dev()`, `box()`, `codeScan()` and `ico()`.
  - `EDGES` entries are `[id, svgPath, class, labelLines, lx, ly, anchor]`.
  - `SEQ` entries are `[edgeId|null, nodeLitOnArrival, durationMs?]`.
  - `LANE` maps each node to its lane.
  - The loop length is `START + steps * STEP + HOLD`.
  - On cycle reset, `.on`, `.hot` and `.seen` are removed from the whole SVG, so keep any persistent state (such as counters) outside those classes.
- **Repeated ids:** several slides reuse ids such as `nIssue`, `nDev1` and `nDev2`, and constants such as `HOLD`. When editing, make `old_str` unique by including nearby slide-specific context.
